info.title: OpenHabit
info.description: OpenHabit API provides endpoints for daily habit tracking, completion toggling, daily journaling, and visualization data (week grid, year heatmap, life grid). All endpoints require Sanctum token authentication.

get.description:
Returns habits, completion progress, daily note, and activity heatmap data
for a specific date. Defaults to today when no date is provided.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date to retrieve tracking data for. Defaults to today.

post.description:
Marks a habit as completed (or uncompleted) for a given date.
Returns the refreshed daily tracking data.

Creates or updates the user's journal note for a specific date.
Send null content to clear the note.

get.description:
Returns all habits including Franklin's Virtues (distinguishable via is_franklin_virtue),
along with translations for the edit page.

minSortOrder.description: Minimum sort_order value for regular habits.

get.description:
Returns translations and settings needed by the habit form
when creating a new habit.

habitTranslations.description: Translations for habit attributes, including frequency and day labels.

get.description:
Returns the habit with parsed RRule data for the edit form,
along with translations and settings needed by the habit form.

habitTranslations.description: Translations for habit attributes, including frequency and day labels.

delete.description:
Soft-deletes the habit, or force-deletes if no completions exist.
Reorders remaining habits to close the sort_order gap.

post.summary: Toggle all Franklin virtue habits active/inactive for the authenticated user
Reorder habits by providing habit IDs in desired order

post.description:
Creates a new habit from the given template and returns
the updated habit list in edit format.
post.summary: Copy a template to the current user

parameters.description: Start date of the week to display.

days.description: Week day headers for the grid.

habits.description: Habit rows with daily completion statuses.

get.description: Returns weekly activity data for the selected life year (age).

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Year index (age) for the year grid (0–79).

translations.description: Translations for the year view tab.

activityData.description: Weekly activity data for the selected life year.

get.description: Returns yearly activity data and life statistics for the memento mori visualization.

translations.description: Translations for the life view tab.

activityData.description: Yearly activity data for the life heatmap.
